name: step_heading_lookup_value
description: Counts down a per-object timer and advances an index through a lookup table each time it expires. When the timer runs out it chooses one of two tables from the signed difference between the object's heading and a target heading, wrapped to a full turn, and stores the looked-up value in the object record.

name: fill_plane_block_color_one
description: Fills a rectangular block of a four-plane screen buffer, forty bytes per row, by setting the first bitplane to ones and clearing the other three, which gives every pixel colour index one. A few extra margin bytes at the block edges are cleared too, and the block size is read from a lookup table.

name: initialise_object_state_and_update
description: Sets a per-object state block to fixed start values: a counter of one, a flag word, and two cleared fields. It then runs the update routine once and sets a byte in the object record to all ones.

name: copy_bitplane_rows_between_buffers
description: Copies rectangular blocks of four-plane bitmap data row by row from a source buffer into a destination buffer, moving each bitplane at its own fixed offset. A shorter tail strip is copied after the main block, using a different row pitch.

name: scan_object_list_and_mark
description: Walks a chain of object records until its counter runs out, skipping the record whose index matches a stored value. Each visited record gets its flag byte set, and a scaled product is compared against a stored threshold, which updates the record's counters when reached.

name: dispatch_cell_handler_by_position
description: Tests whether a position lies inside a window, converts it into a grid cell using two base values, and reads a handler code from that cell. It then calls the matching handler, returning early when the code is negative; positions outside the window take a separate path.

name: queue_block_draw_pass_set
description: Issues four passes of parameter words to one shared memory-mapped target, advancing the source and destination pointers by one block width on each pass. A helper routine is called between passes, and the set ends with a fixed control word.

name: queue_block_draw_pass_set
description: Issues four passes of parameter words to one shared memory-mapped target, advancing the source and destination pointers by one block width on each pass. A helper routine is called between passes, and the set ends with a fixed control word.

name: queue_offset_block_draw_passes
description: Issues four passes of parameter words to the same shared target as its neighbours, but with a different vertical offset and a different control word. Source and destination advance by one block per pass.

name: queue_strip_draw_commands
description: Writes parameter-word groups for a strip of blocks to a shared target. Each pass advances the source and destination by one block width, with a closing group that uses its own control word after the repeated passes.

name: reset_state_vblank_paused
description: Clears two per-object state fields, then turns off the vertical blank interrupt, calls two helper routines, and turns it back on. The two fields are cleared again at the end.

name: increment_frame_counter
description: Adds one to a 16-bit frame counter stored in the current game-state block and returns with the register values unchanged.

name: poll_fire_button_input
description: Increments the frame counter, then reads the fire-button register and the right and middle button register. It updates the per-state press and hold flags from those readings and clears them when a button has been released.

name: process_fire_button_state
description: Stores the current fire input in a global and clears the held-fire state when the input matches a stored value. When a press is present it either counts how long the button is held or starts the firing sequence.

name: fire_projectiles_from_free_slots
description: When fire input is active and the trigger is ready, sets a trigger count to eight and fills free entries of a seven-slot projectile table. Each new entry's position comes from the owner state and a scaled lookup, using helper routines.

name: launch_projectile_group_unchecked
description: Runs the same projectile filling logic as its neighbour, but without the zero-flag test on entry. It fills free projectile slots whenever the fire input is nonzero and the trigger value is not negative.

name: spawn_projectile_group_secondary
description: Handles the other branch of the fire-trigger case, computing spawn values from the owner's position and a lookup. It then calls the projectile fill helper when the trigger is ready and the owner has a shot count left.

name: fill_projectile_slots_with_coords
description: Sets the trigger count to eight, then writes a new projectile record into each free slot of a seven-entry table. Each position is computed from the owner's coordinates and an angle lookup, and the owner's remaining shot count is decremented.

name: write_projectile_record
description: Computes the position and angle components of one projectile from the owner's coordinates and a scaled lookup. It stores them into the projectile record and decrements the owner's remaining shot count.

name: claim_free_projectile_slot
description: Searches a table of seven-word projectile records for the first record whose first word is the free marker. It fills that record with a new position and decrements the owner's shot count, and it takes a separate path when no slot is free.

name: compute_object_display_position
description: Computes an object's on-screen position from its stored coordinates, using a scaled lookup for the vertical component. It writes the packed position words into the object's display entry, choosing the target from a pointer table or the object's own buffer according to its state.

name: write_display_position_words
description: Takes a position from the input registers, scales it through a lookup, and writes the packed position words into one of two display entries chosen from the object's state. The entry is picked from the state flag, with the second entry used when a flag is set.

name: enable_sprite_dma_entry
description: Writes the object's two position words into its sprite display entry and records that entry's address in globals. It then sets the sprite DMA enable bit through the global that mirrors the DMA control register.

name: run_phase_step_handler
description: Runs the handler for the object's current phase. A timed step fires first when its flag is set, then phase zero issues a fixed control word, while phase one checks the object against a 20-entry table of rectangles to pick a target.

name: check_rectangle_target_hit
description: Runs one phase step for the object. When its state is eight it calls a handler, and in phase zero it issues a control word. In phase one it scans a 20-entry rectangle table for an entry containing the object and records a hit as the target.

name: find_point_inside_rectangle_entry
description: Walks a list of rectangle entries, each with four bounds, until it finds one that contains the given point. The matching entry index is stored in the object state, and when nothing matches the routine moves on to the phase-four handling.

name: check_object_overlap_box
description: In phase four, and only while the object is below a fixed coordinate limit, it builds a bounding box around the object. It tests that box against each entry in a list and, on overlap, marks the entry as active and sets the object's display state.

name: dispatch_indexed_handler_and_store
description: Calls a handler chosen by the index in the data register and notes whether a follow-up flag is set. It then writes a fixed control word, stores three passed values into the object state, and returns the fourth value unchanged.

name: prepare_object_record_pointer
description: Resets a state counter. When a pending flag is set it points the object at a record chosen by an offset and sets a mode value from the sign of the input. Otherwise it records the frame counter, sets the pending flag, and copies a stored value into the record when a bit is set.

name: dispatch_phase_handlers_and_test
description: Calls one or two phase handlers from a pointer table, depending on the object's phase number. In phase four, within a coordinate limit, it builds the object's box and tests it against the target list, setting the target when it overlaps.

name: call_phase_handler_box_test
description: Calls the phase handler selected by the index in the input value, then in phase four and within a coordinate limit builds the object's box. It tests the box against the target list and sets the target on overlap.

name: advance_object_phase
description: Advances the object's phase counter, or resets it to zero when the input value is eight. Either way it issues a fixed control word, clears a timer field, and stores three passed values before returning the fourth.

name: increment_phase_and_store_values
description: Issues a fixed control word, increments the object's phase counter, and clears a timer field. It then stores three passed values into the object state and returns the fourth value unchanged.

name: find_overlapping_target_entry
description: Builds a bounding box around the object, issues a control word, and walks a list of records until an active one overlaps the box. The overlapping record becomes the object's target pointer and sets its display state.

name: scan_records_for_box_overlap
description: Issues a control word, then builds a bounding box for the object and walks the record list. It stops at the first record whose bounds overlap the box and stores that record as the object's target.

name: mark_phase_started_and_advance
description: Sets a started flag and calls a helper, then issues a control word. It increments the object's phase counter, clears a timer field, and stores three passed values before returning the fourth.

name: match_box_against_record_list
description: Issues a control word, builds the object's bounding box, and tests it against each record's bounds in turn. A record that overlaps the box is used as the object's target, and the scan stops at that record.

name: scan_records_in_region
description: Writes two fixed control values and a clear word, then walks a list of records. It tests each record against a region given by four input values, and an overlapping record updates the object's target and its position fields.

name: load_target_and_advance_phase
description: Copies a target value from the input record into the object state, sets a flag, increments the object's phase, and clears a timer field. It then stores three passed values and returns the fourth.

name: copy_four_plane_segments
description: Copies eight consecutive forty-byte segments from each of the four bitplanes between two screen buffers. Both pointers advance by one segment per pass, and each plane keeps its fixed offset.

name: dispatch_by_code_table_entry
description: Returns at once for a zero code. For codes twelve and twenty-four it calls the handler at one table offset, and for every other nonzero code it calls the handler at a second table offset.

name: call_handler_for_code_group
description: Calls one of two handlers from a table, choosing the first when the code is twelve or twenty-four and the second otherwise.

name: call_fixed_table_handler
description: Calls the handler stored at one fixed offset in a pointer table, with no conditions.

name: call_handler_at_offset
description: Calls the handler at the table offset given in the data register.

name: call_positioned_handler_from_record
description: Looks up a handler through a pointer in the object record and calls it with the record's position field added to a base value.

name: call_current_entry_handler
description: Calls the handler named in the entry that the object state currently points to, passing that entry's stored offset plus the object's base value.

name: activate_object_and_record_position
description: Resets a counter, and when the object is active it points at the matching record and sets a mode value from the input. It calls helpers, copies the object's position, and copies the frame counter into the state.

name: build_glyph_list_from_text
description: Copies a text string up to a colon separator into a buffer and measures it. It then walks the text backwards, building a list of pointers into an eight-byte-per-character glyph table, and accumulates a running value from each glyph's first byte.

name: advance_record_cycle_and_lookup
description: When the object is active it advances a small cycle index stored in the record by the input value, wrapping back to zero above four. If the record's sentinel is negative, it scans a list for an entry with the same key and copies the matching value into the record.

name: advance_record_cycle_and_lookup
description: When the object is active it advances a small cycle index stored in the record by the input value, wrapping back to zero above four. If the record's sentinel is negative, it scans a list for an entry with the same key and copies the matching value into the record.

name: toggle_flag_and_lookup_key
description: When the object is active it toggles a flag byte in the record. If the record's sentinel is negative, it scans a list for a matching key and stores the matched flag value in the record.

name: repeat_helper_twenty_times
description: Clears a state flag, calls a helper twenty times in a loop, and then restores the flag. It then calls three more helpers and returns the value passed through.

name: call_three_helpers_in_order
description: Calls three helper routines one after another and returns the value passed through.

name: call_two_helpers_in_order
description: Calls two helper routines one after another and returns the value passed through.

name: call_one_helper_passthrough
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the value passed through unchanged.

name: call_one_helper_passthrough
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the value passed through unchanged.

name: call_one_helper_passthrough
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the value passed through unchanged.

name: call_one_helper_passthrough
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the value passed through unchanged.

name: call_helper_return_data_regs
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the two data register values that were passed in.

name: call_helpers_with_saved_field
description: Saves a field in the object state, sets it to a value taken from the address register, and calls two helpers. It then restores the saved field and returns the data register values.

name: call_indexed_handler_table
description: Calls one entry of a pointer table, selected by the value in the data register and stepped in groups of four bytes.

name: toggle_flag_and_draw_text
description: Toggles a flag in the object record while it is active, and looks up a matching key when the record's sentinel is set. It then draws a text label built from the stored value, padded in steps based on the accumulated glyph values.

name: select_and_draw_label_text
description: Chooses one of two text strings from the program data according to a flag in the record, skips leading spaces, and builds the glyph pointer list needed to draw it.

name: draw_fixed_label_text
description: Measures a fixed text string from the program data, builds a glyph pointer for each character, and positions the string by its accumulated width.

name: format_and_draw_text_buffer
description: Writes a fixed character and a terminator into a text buffer, skips leading spaces, and builds the glyph pointer list for the resulting string, positioned by its accumulated width.

name: draw_text_from_pointer
description: Measures a text string passed in through the address register, builds a glyph pointer for each character, and positions the list by its accumulated width.

name: advance_record_cycle_and_lookup
description: When the object is active it advances a small cycle index stored in the record by the input value, wrapping back to zero above four. If the record's sentinel is negative, it scans a list for an entry with the same key and copies the matching value into the record.

name: draw_status_label_text
description: Chooses a status string according to a phase byte in the record, using a fixed label for phases zero and four. It then builds the glyph pointer list for the chosen string, positioned by its accumulated width.

name: draw_flag_text_glyphs
description: Draws a text label chosen by the input value: a fixed label for one code, and otherwise a short two-character string written into the buffer. The glyph pointer list is built for whichever text is chosen.

name: draw_two_char_buffer_label
description: Writes a two-character label into a buffer at the record, then builds the glyph pointer list for it, positioned by its accumulated width.

name: format_signed_number_text
description: Takes the absolute value of the input number and writes it as decimal text. A zero value writes a fixed dash character instead, and the resulting text is then built into a glyph pointer list.

name: clear_text_buffer_and_draw
description: Writes a terminator at the start of a text buffer, then builds the glyph pointer list for the record's text, positioned by its accumulated width.

name: format_number_field_text
description: Takes a number from one field of the record, corrects its sign, converts it to decimal text in a buffer, and builds the glyph pointer list for drawing it.

name: format_record_count_text
description: Formats a count field from the record as decimal text, with the sign corrected first. It clears a status flag when the object is active and builds the glyph pointer list for drawing the text.

name: format_signed_field_text
description: Formats a signed field from the record as decimal text. Fixed characters are written into the buffer first, and then the glyph pointer list is built for drawing the result.

name: format_record_value_text
description: Takes a value from a second field of the record, corrects its sign, and converts it to decimal text in a buffer. The glyph pointer list is then built for drawing the text.

name: compare_distance_scaled_roll
description: Checks whether the record's target is still eligible. When the distance is inside a limit it decrements a counter and compares a byte from a helper against a chance value that falls off with distance, and that comparison decides the outcome.

name: draw_bit_pattern_and_digits
description: Toggles one bit in a bitplane byte, sets several bytes of a screen pattern, and writes up to three decimal digits of a value into a text buffer.

name: write_three_digit_value
description: Writes a value as decimal digits into a text buffer, skipping leading digits that are zero, and updates a few screen bytes first.

name: write_decimal_digits
description: Writes an unsigned value as decimal digits into a text buffer, skipping leading zero digits and always writing at least a units digit.

name: write_one_or_two_digits
description: Writes a value as one or two decimal digits into a text buffer, writing a tens digit only when the value is above nine.

name: draw_text_centred_in_field
description: Measures a text string from the address register, builds a glyph pointer for each character, and positions the list centred in a field using the accumulated glyph width.

name: render_glyph_list_to_bitplanes
description: Draws a list of glyphs into four-plane screen memory. Each glyph row is shifted by a sub-byte horizontal offset and combined into the planes with OR and XOR operations, and the position advances by one glyph width each time.

name: draw_glyph_list_with_shift
description: Draws a fixed number of glyphs from a list into four-plane screen memory, shifting each glyph's rows by a horizontal sub-byte offset and combining them into the planes.

name: render_glyph_strip_bitplanes
description: Draws a strip of glyph rows into four-plane screen memory, counting down a glyph count and shifting each row by its offset before combining it with the planes.

name: stub_return_only
description: The routine does nothing and returns at once, so it is a placeholder with no effect on the state or the screen.

name: refresh_grid_cell_cache
description: Converts the object's coordinates into grid cells by dividing by a fixed scale. When the cell changes it refreshes a cached table of entries for the new cell, and otherwise it reuses the cache.

name: refresh_grid_cell_cache
description: Converts the object's coordinates into grid cells by dividing by a fixed scale. When the cell changes it refreshes a cached table of entries for the new cell, and otherwise it reuses the cache.

name: refresh_grid_cell_cache
description: Converts the object's coordinates into grid cells by dividing by a fixed scale. When the cell changes it refreshes a cached table of entries for the new cell, and otherwise it reuses the cache.

name: refresh_grid_cell_cache
description: Converts the object's coordinates into grid cells by dividing by a fixed scale. When the cell changes it refreshes a cached table of entries for the new cell, and otherwise it reuses the cache. It also calls three helper routines during the update.

name: build_pairwise_range_table
description: Fills a fifteen-by-fifteen table with projection values for pairs of entries from two lookup tables. Each pair's difference is scaled and clamped to a fixed range, and pairs that cannot be projected are marked with a sentinel.

name: build_pairwise_range_table
description: Fills a fifteen-by-fifteen table with projection values for pairs of entries from two lookup tables. Each pair's difference is scaled and clamped to a fixed range, and pairs that cannot be projected are marked with a sentinel.

name: advance_stepped_fill_sequence
description: When its step counter reaches eight it clears a set of columns in screen memory to the fill value and resets its accumulator. Otherwise it stores the current pointer, subtracts a fixed amount from the accumulator, and steps the counter down by four.

name: scan_index_list_for_hits
description: Walks a list of entry indices and, for each entry not yet marked, marks it and examines three related entries. It calls a helper when those entries qualify, and the walk stops at a zero terminator.

name: sort_triplet_and_test_edges
description: Orders three values from a table by size, then checks their flags and calls a helper when the qualifying pair is found.

name: compute_edge_span_deltas
description: Computes the horizontal and vertical differences between two entries and sets up the values used for a span fill, taking the sign of each difference into account.

name: fill_clamped_vertical_span
description: Clamps a vertical range to a fixed window and writes a fill value into a column of screen rows across the four bitplanes, stepping forty bytes per row.

name: build_row_offset_table
description: Fills a table of two hundred words with the byte offset of each screen row, stepping forty bytes per row. It also builds a sixteen-entry bit-mask table by rotating a pattern, then clears the object state and calls the update helper.

name: poll_input_and_move_object
description: Increments a frame counter and reads the fire-button and secondary-button registers. It then computes the object's next position fields from its stored coordinates and updates the fire state.

name: update_display_state_with_dma
description: Updates the frame's display state by recording the current fire value and advancing the phase counter while fire is active. It then builds the object's display position words and enables or disables DMA channels through the DMA control register.

name: advance_phase_modulo_ten
description: Sets a record field from a table indexed by the input value, negating a second field for one specific input. While the object's phase is active it advances the phase counter modulo ten, and at phase four with a fire state it computes the record's position words from the object's coordinates.

name: advance_phase_modulo_ten
description: Sets a record field from a table indexed by the input value, negating a second field for one specific input. While the object's phase is active it advances the phase counter modulo ten, and at phase four with a fire state it computes the record's position words from the object's coordinates.

name: update_record_near_point
description: Searches a list of records for the first active one whose stored position lies within a small box around the input point. For the match it updates the record's counters for the current phase, then calls the update helper.

name: spawn_display_entry_when_armed
description: When the armed flag is set and the phase matches, it builds new entries from the object's coordinates across a list and calls helper routines to finish each one.

name: load_mask_pair_from_table
description: Copies a pair of 32-bit mask values from a table into the object state. The table index is a field of the input record multiplied by eight, and the helper routine is called afterwards.

name: composite_masked_bitplanes
description: Combines source bitplane words with the destination in groups of four, using a stored mask and shift. Masked destination bits are cleared and the shifted source bits are ORed in, with each group spanning four bitplanes at fixed offsets.

name: copy_sprite_entries_from_list
description: Reads a list of display entries terminated by a negative word. It copies each entry's coordinates, row offsets and attribute word into the object's records, replacing one attribute value with a fixed constant.

name: copy_sprite_entries_from_list
description: Reads a list of display entries terminated by a negative word. It copies each entry's coordinates, row offsets and attribute word into the object's records, replacing one attribute value with a fixed constant.

name: copy_sprite_entries_from_list
description: Reads a list of display entries terminated by a negative word. It copies each entry's coordinates, row offsets and attribute word into the object's records, replacing one attribute value with a fixed constant.

name: copy_sprite_entries_from_list
description: Reads a list of display entries terminated by a negative word. It copies each entry's coordinates, row offsets and attribute word into the object's records, replacing one attribute value with a fixed constant.

name: claim_empty_record_slots
description: Walks sixteen records of 96 bytes each and sets a word field to the input value in every record whose field is zero, so every free record is claimed.

name: walk_record_chain_for_mask
description: Walks a chain of records linked by a relative offset, stopping at the first record whose mask word passes the flag test. The mode word selects which link field is followed, and the found record is stored in the state.

name: walk_record_chain_for_mask
description: Walks a chain of records linked by a relative offset, stopping at the first record whose mask word passes the flag test. The mode word selects which link field is followed, and the found record is stored in the state.

name: walk_record_chain_for_mask
description: Walks a chain of records linked by a relative offset, stopping at the first record whose mask word passes the flag test. The mode word selects which link field is followed, and the found record is stored in the state.

name: start_blitter_block_copy
description: Waits for the blitter to be free, then programs its mask, modulo, control and size registers for a block copy. The destination is computed from the object's position and a row stride. A second blit with a different control word follows when the object is past a coordinate limit.

name: start_blitter_masked_sprite
description: Waits for the blitter to be free, programs its mask words, modulo and size registers, and starts a masked block copy using two pointers from the object record.

name: compute_column_bit_mask
description: For an x coordinate inside the range of minus fifteen to 319, computes a shift value and a bit mask for one column. It stores them with a derived byte offset in the blitter setup words, and positions outside the range return early.

name: compute_column_bit_mask_alt
description: Works like its neighbour for an x coordinate inside the range of minus fifteen to 319, but stores the computed mask and shift in alternate words. Positions outside the range return early.

name: compute_column_bit_mask_alt
description: Works like its neighbour for an x coordinate inside the range of minus fifteen to 319, but stores the computed mask and shift in alternate words. Positions outside the range return early.

name: compute_column_bit_mask
description: For an x coordinate inside the range of minus fifteen to 319, computes a shift value and a bit mask for one column. It stores them with a derived byte offset in the blitter setup words, and positions outside the range return early.

name: compute_column_bit_mask_alt
description: For an x coordinate inside the range of minus fifteen to 319, computes a shift value and bit mask for one column. The results go into the alternate target words, and positions outside the range return early.

name: program_column_strip_blits
description: Computes column mask values for an x coordinate, then waits for the blitter and programs its registers for a set of strip blits. An interrupt source is disabled during the blit setup and enabled again afterwards.

name: queue_plane_blit_sequence
description: Runs four passes that each program the blitter with a mask pair, a control word and a size word. The destination advances by one bitplane per pass, and each pass waits for the blitter to be free before starting.

name: queue_clipped_blit_sequence
description: Computes a start offset from a state value, using a default when that value is negative. It then runs four blit passes that program the blitter with size and control words, advancing one bitplane per pass.

name: queue_fixed_blit_sequence
description: Sets fixed start offset and size words, then runs four blit passes, advancing one bitplane per pass and waiting for the blitter before each start.

name: queue_two_stage_blit_sequence
description: Issues one blit with a first set of offsets, then runs the four-pass blit loop with a second set of offsets.

name: queue_scaled_blit_sequence
description: Sets the start offset and size words from a state value, runs one blit, then runs the four-pass loop with offsets computed from the same value.

name: run_four_plane_blit_loop
description: Waits for the blitter, then runs four passes that program mask, control and size words from preset values. The destination advances by one bitplane per pass.

name: render_tile_rows_to_screen
description: Walks a range of tile columns and rows between two bounds, calling helper routines to draw each cell into the screen buffer.

name: stub_return_only
description: The routine does nothing and returns at once, so it is a placeholder with no effect on the state or the screen.

name: copy_planes_and_clear_rows
description: Copies a block of four-plane screen data from one buffer into four working planes, then fills a band of rows with all-ones words.

name: swap_buffers_after_vblank
description: Swaps the two buffer pointers stored in the object record and marks the record as updated. It then waits for the vertical blank flag before re-enabling that interrupt source.

name: copy_working_planes_to_screen
description: Copies four working planes back into a block of four-plane screen data, reversing the direction of the copy used by its neighbour.

name: build_scroll_column_mask
description: Clears a block of ten state words, then uses a helper value to place a bit-pattern byte in a column buffer and decrement a run of bytes. It stores a derived offset in the state for the next column.

name: clamp_view_window_to_object
description: Chooses window limits from a mode flag, then clamps the object's coordinates into that window. The clamped position and the window size are stored in the state.

name: scan_targets_with_weighted_score
description: Initialises a search state, then loops over candidate records and computes a weighted score from a byte in each record and a table value. The loop stops when the helper reports the end of the list.

name: update_record_heading_toward_target
description: Takes a target value from the record or from a helper, then moves the record's stored value toward it by a step limited by a speed shift. The result is kept within a wrap-around range of one full turn.

name: apply_scaled_axis_step
description: Looks up a table value for a direction, multiplies it by an input factor, and adds the shifted result to the record's two position fields. The shift comes from a state value.

name: run_sixteen_step_division
description: Takes the absolute differences between an input point and the record's position, then runs a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop that produces a fixed-point ratio of the two.

name: run_sixteen_step_division
description: Takes the absolute differences between an input point and the record's position, then runs a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop that produces a fixed-point ratio of the two.

name: run_sixteen_step_division
description: Takes the absolute differences between an input point and the record's position, then runs a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop that produces a fixed-point ratio of the two.

name: clear_entry_fields_per_record
description: Walks a list of entries until a negative terminator. For each entry it clears a block of byte fields in the object state, then builds per-entry data from the entry's coordinates.

name: render_tile_entries_to_planes
description: Walks a list of tile entries terminated by a negative word. For each tile it looks up the bitmap offset, then combines the tile's plane bytes into the screen buffer using masks from a lookup table.

name: build_line_span_table
description: Steps a fixed-point line from one end to the other, writing an index and an accumulated position into a list for each step. A terminator is appended, and a second list is built afterwards from the same stepping.

name: select_target_index_for_update
description: Checks whether the object's current entry has changed since the last call. If it has not, it returns a status code based on the entry's flags and a shared condition.

name: select_target_index_reset
description: Clears the change flags, then returns the current entry index when it has changed. Otherwise it returns a status code based on the entry's flags.

name: check_target_status_code
description: Returns zero for an entry with no status, the status code from the entry when a shared condition is met, and a fixed code otherwise. It also updates the change flags on the way.

name: check_target_status_code
description: Returns zero for an entry with no status, the status code from the entry when a shared condition is met, and a fixed code otherwise. It also updates the change flags on the way.

name: check_target_status_flags
description: Reads the entry's status from one of two sources and returns zero when it is empty. Otherwise it tests a shared condition and a group of flag words, and sets the change flags when they match.

name: stub_return_only
description: The routine does nothing and returns at once, so it is a placeholder with no effect on the state or the screen.

name: start_target_sequence_from_table
description: When the entry's status is nonzero and the state allows it, scans a table for an entry whose code is not six. It writes that entry's parameter words to the display and records the frame counter for the next step.

name: stub_return_only

name: reset_sequence_phase_flag
description: Clears one word in the object state, which resets the sequence phase flag, and returns.

name: append_entry_to_sequence_table
description: Looks for a free slot in a table of up to thirty-two entries. When one is found it stores the pointer, offset and value from the input and sets the slot's sequence number.

name: advance_sequence_state_machine
description: Runs a four-phase sequence. The first phase searches a table for an entry marked active, the later phases advance depending on a flag, and helper routines are called at each step.

name: render_text_row_to_bitplanes
description: Draws a null-terminated text string into four-plane screen memory one character cell at a time. A space fills the cell with a fixed pattern, and any other character copies its glyph rows into the planes through a mask taken from the state.

name: format_long_as_decimal
description: Converts a 32-bit value into decimal text by repeated subtraction against a table of powers of ten. A negative value starts with a minus sign, and the digits are written into the buffer.

name: format_long_as_decimal
description: Converts a 32-bit value into decimal text by repeated subtraction against a table of powers of ten. A negative value starts with a minus sign, and the digits are written into the buffer.

name: render_text_row_to_bitplanes
description: Draws a null-terminated text string into four-plane screen memory one character cell at a time. A space fills the cell with a fixed pattern, and any other character copies its glyph rows into the planes through a mask taken from the state.

name: tick_timed_record_scan
description: Subtracts a speed-scaled amount from a timer and, when the timer falls below its threshold, lowers the threshold and runs a record search with a mask. It returns early while a stop flag is set.

name: tick_timed_record_scan
description: Subtracts a speed-scaled amount from a timer and, when the timer falls below its threshold, lowers the threshold and runs a record search with a mask. It returns early while a stop flag is set.

name: scan_entries_negating_first_negative
description: Scans eight word entries for the first negative value, negates it, and calls the update helper until the record's flag shows the search is complete. It then stores the state values back.

name: resume_negated_entry_scan
description: Continues from the entry after the current one, negating the next negative value it finds. It calls the update helper until the record's flag shows the search is complete.

name: store_state_values_and_return
description: Stores three input values and one trailing value into the object state fields, then returns.

name: load_default_entry_table
description: Copies a table of twenty-five entries, twelve bytes each, into the object's entry list. It then fills two words of each copied entry from a helper routine's output, repeating for the remaining entries.

name: copy_background_planes_to_screen
description: When the object's flag is set and the mode is clear, it copies a four-plane background block into the screen buffer, writing each plane at its own fixed offset. It then renders the remaining entries.

name: add_digit_string_with_carry
description: Adds a table value to an eight-character decimal string, propagating the carry from the least significant digit. The result is written back as ASCII digits.

name: subtract_digit_string_with_borrow
description: Subtracts a table of digit values from an eight-character decimal string, propagating the borrow. The result is written back as ASCII digits.

name: draw_information_screen_panels
description: Draws a fixed text-based information screen. It uses labels referenced by the program, such as category headings and status words, and copies bitplane image data into the screen buffer.

name: wait_for_fire_press_release
description: Polls the port A and pot input registers in a fixed sequence, returning once the button state has cycled from pressed to released.

name: animate_and_draw_object_frame
description: Advances a four-step animation counter. For each record that matches the current step it computes an on-screen position from the record's coordinates and an angle lookup, then calls helpers to draw the frame.

name: update_current_target_selection
description: Compares the input entry with the object's current entry and, when they match, marks the selection active and clears a 180-byte table to ones. It swaps the current and previous entry indices when a flag matches.

name: match_entry_to_record_index
description: When the entry's index is marked unused, searches a list of records for the one whose index matches the object's stored index. It then copies the entry's position and flag fields into that record.

name: search_entries_by_stride
description: Searches a list for an entry whose value matches the object's current value, stepping through the list by a field stored in each entry. It sets the found flag when the search completes, and calls a helper to finish when nothing matches.

name: draw_rotated_sprite_blit
description: Chooses a frame from the object's angle, computes a source offset, and waits for the blitter. It then programs the blitter with the frame's position and size words and starts the sprite blit.

name: find_nearby_target_entry
description: Returns the current value unchanged while the selection is active. Otherwise it checks the entry's flags and, for an entry without the special bit, searches nearby records whose positions lie within a margin of 150 units, returning the matched entry's value.

name: select_special_entry_target
description: For an entry with the special flag set, runs a search over the entries with a fixed mask. When the search completes, it stores the matched entry's index as the current target.

name: run_effect_countdown_frame
description: While its state value is set, it counts the value down and resets the object when the count passes a limit. Otherwise it walks a table of effect cells, reseeding empty cells from a shared value and drawing the active cells into the bitplanes.

name: fill_free_slots_from_table
description: Fills up to eight free slots in a pending list with entries from the object's table. For each one it copies the entry's flags and coordinates into the record and calls helper routines.

name: update_all_active_records
description: Walks the active record list and updates each record, calling helper routines for movement, drawing and state changes. Flagged records take a different branch, and the walk covers the whole list.

name: update_record_flags_and_timers
description: Walks a record list in which flag and counter fields drive each record's state. Records whose counters pass a limit get a flag word set, and matched records are handled through helper routines.

name: update_tracked_entry_pair
description: Compares the input entry with two tracked indices and clears any tracked pair that matches. When the entry matches the first tracked index, it also marks the target as cleared.

name: call_five_helpers_in_order
description: Calls five helper routines one after another and returns the value passed through.

name: repeat_helper_until_zero
description: Calls a helper repeatedly, calling a second helper after each call, until the first helper returns zero.

name: walk_flagged_record_list
description: Walks a list of records that ends with an all-ones marker. Each record's flag bits select a branch: some branches test whether a point lies inside the record's bounds and return on a hit, and others call helper routines.

name: advance_pseudorandom_seed
description: Advances a 16-bit pseudorandom seed by multiplying it by 125 and reducing the result modulo 65521, then returns.

name: append_list_entry_with_bounds
description: Adds an entry to a list of bounding boxes. It sets the entry's first flag, accumulates a position from pairs of offsets until a sentinel, and stores the resulting bounds and a terminator in the list.

name: reset_list_terminator
description: Writes an all-ones terminator at the list's current end and moves the list pointer past it.

name: initialise_record_from_table_entry
description: Fills a new record from a table entry. It sets the record's source pointer and position fields, chooses one of two value fields depending on the entry's type code, and copies the remaining attributes.

name: finish_record_initialisation
description: Copies the remaining attributes from the source record and sets the default state values. It then adjusts the flag word for two special flag bits.

name: return_passthrough_value
description: Returns the value passed in without changing anything.

name: call_mode_helper_once
description: Sets up a helper call with a fixed mode and mask, calls the helper once, and returns the value passed through.

name: call_mode_five_helper
description: Sets the search mode to five with a fixed mask, calls the search helper once, and returns the value passed through.

name: call_helper_passthrough_value
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the values passed through, with no change in either branch of the check.

name: search_list_for_mask_match
description: Sets the search mode to five with a fixed mask and calls the search helper. It then walks the returned list until an entry passes the mask test, returning that entry's value, or zero if none does.

name: call_mode_five_helper
description: Sets the search mode to five with a fixed mask, calls the search helper once, and returns the value passed through.
